_doc: Which role uses which skill and which account. tools/check.py reads this. skills: role -> skill folders under skills/<role>/ ('bot-guards' means guards/). accounts: name a role charter uses -> path in the pack that serves it (or null), and key names (SIGNIN for a sign-in Justin does).
_worker: dev and hermes-builder are worker-box lanes, not Grok roles: the worker's CLIs and Hermes load these skills (worker-box/jobs.json). markets' market-signals and creator-follow also run on the worker.
